paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: Random (light color) and random (darker color) performance comparison with different perturbation setups and the unperturbed trained model variants (orange bars). Left-to-right: Blue: Accuracy of the embedding and first layers' probes; Green: Random models with pre-trained embedding layer: no perturbation, , , , ; Red: Random models where the embedding layer is random as well: no perturbation, , , , ; Orange: Unperturbed trained models.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores of several model variants, categorized along the horizontal axis. The horizontal axis labels represent different model configurations, including "1st layer," "layers," "random +B1," "random +L2," "random +permute," "random +B2," "random +L2," "random +permute," and "unperturbed." The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy," displays numerical values on a linear scale ranging from approximately 70 to 95, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The bars are colored in blue, green, red, and orange, representing different model types. Blue bars, associated with "embedding" and "1st layer" models, exhibit values between roughly 72 and 76. Green bars, labeled "random," demonstrate a range of accuracies from approximately 73 to 83. The red bars, denoting "random +B2" and "random +L2" models, display values generally between 66 and 72. Finally, the orange bars, representing "unperturbed" models, have values ranging from approximately 88 to 92. The bars are arranged from left to right in a specific order defined by the model configurations. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding that distinguishes model types indicated in the caption.
